summary: Harrow, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Viatris Inc. on August 3, 2026, to acquire global rights to TYRVAYA nasal spray, a dry eye treatment. Consideration is $30 million cash at closing plus up to $70 million in contingent milestone payments tied to annual net sales thresholds. The deal includes regulatory approvals, IP, inventory, and assumed liabilities, with customary closing conditions and a transition services agreement. Closing is expected in H2 2026, funded from cash on hand. Watch for regulatory clearance and sales milestone triggers.
